purpose: Test whether the 7-piece nine-car v3.2 board / joint504 distribution has more value when converted to wide tickets than when treated as an ordered trifecta formation.

protocol.participation: v3.2 collapse filter; skipped races bet 0 yen
protocol.board: v3.2 greedy joint504 budget 7 + strong-state overlay
protocol.wide_pair_probability: sum joint504 probability mass of every ordered top3 triple containing both riders; order ignored
protocol.payout_credit: published winning ワイド payout_yen; all selected winning wide pairs in a race are credited
